name: Wand of Polymorph
description: A twisted wand of many woods grafted together.
body:
## What it does

Spend a charge to change a creature into a beast.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
